definition: [ חֲסֵן ] verb Haph`el take . . . possession of (Syriac be strong, overcome ; ᵑ7 be strong, take possession of ; Egyptian Aramaic Haph`el חחסן hold property S-C D 2 +, compare Biblical Hebrew חסן ); — Perfect 3 masculine plural הֶחֱסִ֫נ ( K § 38. 3 Kmp on the passage ) Dan 7:22 Imperfect 3 masculine plural יַחְסְנוּן ( K § 38. 1 b )) v Dan 7:18 (perhaps point סִנוּן -).
